# RafaAi

> RafaAi is a student-first AI assistant for learning, solving questions, studying, writing, and understanding difficult topics.

## Official website

https://rafaaii.vercel.app/

## What RafaAi does

- Explains concepts in simple language
- Solves questions step by step
- Helps students study topics
- Helps with writing and everyday tasks
- Provides practice questions
- Supports student-focused learning workflows

## Audience

RafaAi is designed as a student-first AI assistant, including support for school learning and exam preparation.

## Creator

Md Rafaquat
